nameOfQualification: Basic Health and Wellness Skills (Sr. Secondary school)
description: To ensure school students should follow safety measures, first aid, CPR and AED techniques, healthy living habits, practices for sexual and substance abuse prevention, mental and health promotion, disaster preparedness and sensitization on clean, healthy and safe environment. This would habituate them to apply fundamental concepts of healthy body into their daily lifestyle and practice.
typeOfQualification: General, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Ensure the safety measures, abuse prevention measures, CPR, Healthy Lifestyle practices and safe environment practices are followed by everyone

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.EDUCATIONCOMPLETED: Pursuing continuous school education from 11th to 12th Grade
